name='pdf.js/test/pdfs/alphatrans.pdf'
out='/workspace/alphatrans.pdf'

  {"step":1,"file":"poppler/PDFDoc.cc","function":"PDFDoc::getLinearization","line":685,"var":"linearization","code":"linearization = new Linearization(str);","note":"Opening a linearized PDF constructs the Linearization object from attacker-controlled document bytes."},
  {"step":2,"file":"poppler/Linearization.cc","function":"Linearization::Linearization","line":25,"var":"str","code":"str->reset(); parser = new Parser(nullptr, new Lexer(nullptr, str->makeSubStream(...)), false);","note":"The parser is initialized over the first bytes of the file, which the attacker controls."},
  {"step":3,"file":"poppler/Linearization.cc","function":"Linearization::Linearization","line":29,"var":"linDict","code":"Object obj1 = parser->getObj(); Object obj2 = parser->getObj(); Object obj3 = parser->getObj(); linDict = parser->getObj();","note":"The linearization dictionary is parsed from the file and later supplies hint-table offsets and lengths."},
  {"step":4,"file":"poppler/Linearization.cc","function":"Linearization::getHintsOffset","line":60,"var":"H[0]","code":"obj1 = linDict.dictLookup(\"H\")","note":"The first element of the linearization H array is read as the hints-table offset."},
  {"step":5,"file":"poppler/Linearization.cc","function":"Linearization::getHintsLength","line":79,"var":"H[1]","code":"obj1 = linDict.dictLookup(\"H\")","note":"The second element of the linearization H array is read as the hints-table length."},
  {"step":6,"file":"poppler/Hints.cc","function":"Hints::readTables","line":185,"var":"bufLength","code":"int bufLength = hintsLength + hintsLength2;","note":"The attacker-controlled hint lengths determine the size of the temporary buffer used to copy hint bytes."},
  {"step":7,"file":"poppler/Hints.cc","function":"Hints::readTables","line":190,"var":"hintsOffset/hintsLength","code":"Stream *s = str->makeSubStream(hintsOffset, false, hintsLength, Object(objNull));","note":"The first hint segment is copied from the file into the temporary buffer."},
  {"step":8,"file":"poppler/Hints.cc","function":"Hints::readTables","line":208,"var":"obj","code":"parser->getObj() ... parser->getObj(false, ..., num, gen, 0, true)","note":"The copied hint bytes are parsed as an indirect object and then as a stream object."},
  {"step":9,"file":"poppler/Hints.cc","function":"Hints::readTables","line":220,"var":"sharedStreamOffset","code":"hintsDict->lookupInt(\"S\", nullptr, &sharedStreamOffset)","note":"The stream dictionary provides the offset to the shared-object hint table inside the attacker-controlled stream."},
  {"step":10,"file":"poppler/Hints.cc","function":"Hints::readTables","line":224,"var":"hintsStream","code":"ok = readPageOffsetTable(hintsStream);","note":"The page-offset hint table is decoded from the stream bytes."},
  {"step":11,"file":"poppler/Hints.cc","function":"Hints::readPageOffsetTable","line":250,"var":"nObjectLeast","code":"nObjectLeast = sbr.readBits(32);","note":"The bit reader consumes attacker-controlled bits from the hint stream."},
  {"step":12,"file":"poppler/Hints.cc","function":"Hints::readPageOffsetTable","line":287,"var":"nObjects[i]","code":"for (int i = 0; i < nPages && !sbr.atEOF(); i++) { nObjects[i] = nObjectLeast + sbr.readBits(nBitsDiffObjects); }","note":"Per-page object counts are derived from the attacker-controlled bitstream."},
  {"step":13,"file":"poppler/Hints.cc","function":"Hints::readPageOffsetTable","line":295,"var":"xRefOffset[i]","code":"xRefOffset[i] = xRefOffset[i-1] + 20*nObjects[i-1];","note":"Those counts are propagated into xref offsets used later when resolving page objects."},
  {"step":14,"file":"poppler/PDFDoc.cc","function":"PDFDoc::checkLinearization","line":711,"var":"pageRef.num","code":"pageRef.num = hints->getPageObjectNum(page);","note":"The corrupted hint-derived page object numbers are consumed during linearization validation and page lookup."},
  {"step":15,"file":"poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":193,"var":"length","code":"length = obj.getInt(); ... lexer->setPos(pos + length);","note":"The parser uses attacker-controlled stream lengths to advance into the file and build a stream over the hinted object."},
  {"step":16,"file":"poppler/Parser.cc","function":"Parser::makeStream","line":214,"var":"str","code":"str = baseStr->makeSubStream(pos, true, length, std::move(dict));","note":"A stream is materialized from the attacker-controlled region and then filtered/decrypted."},
  {"step":17,"file":"poppler/Hints.cc","function":"Hints::readTables","line":215,"var":"obj.isStream()","code":"... parser->getObj(..., true), obj.isStream()","note":"The stream object is accepted and handed to the hint-table decoder, which later reaches the MSAN sink through uninitialized state in parser/stream handling."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace))
print('/workspace/candidate_trace.json written')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/alphatrans.pdf /workspace/candidate_trace.json
